title: AnalyzeRefundEligibilityInput
description: The `data` part of the A2A TaskRequest.input for the analyze_refund_eligibility capability. Sent by a requesting peer (e.g. the customer-resolution-agent) and validated by the billing-entitlement-agent (FR-002). The agent validates the required fields and ignores unknown fields so the wire shape can evolve.

case_id.description: Originating case correlation id. The agent publishes its result event with correlation_id == case_id so the requester's correlation-keyed consumer matches it (research R2).

requested_refund_amount.description: Disputed amount the refund is claimed for.

purchase_reference.description: Primary fact-lookup key: the invoice/charge the refund targets.

customer_message_summary.description: Optional context. Never overrides owned billing facts (FR-009).

policy_context.description: Optional hint. The agent always applies its own published refund policy.
